title: [main] Incorrect depreciation calculation for assets used less than 180 days under Income Tax Act rules
summary: Fixed depreciation calculation for Indian fixed assets used less than 180 days, which previously applied a 50% reduction twice under Income Tax Act rules. The calculation now counts only days the asset is in use and avoids duplicate reductions.
key_points: Removed duplicate 50% reduction that was applied both from setup and hardcoded logic
180-day reduction now counts actual days asset was in use in fiscal year, not calculation run duration
Depreciation calculated against opening fiscal year book value minus already-posted amounts
Prevents over-reduction to 25% when 50% reduction should apply
Later calculation runs in same year only top up to annual depreciation amount
quote: Removed the duplicate reduction, so the reduction from the depreciation book setup is applied only once.
